items.name: sponsorscan
items.description: Finds entry-level postings at employers with real H-1B filing history. Joins DOL OFLC LCA disclosure data with public Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby board APIs, then filters, ranks, and reports. Optional Google Sheets sync and email alerts via GitHub Actions.

items.name: h1b-jobs-extractor
items.description: This repository is designed to assist individuals seeking sponsorships by enabling them to iterate through the Excel sheet provided by the US Department of Labor LCA Programs. It helps identify companies that offer sponsorships. The associated website is https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/foreign-labor/performance#dis.

items.name: perm
items.description: Federal labor certification data read straight from DOL, plus PERM case management for immigration attorneys. Case lookup across PERM, prevailing wage and H-1B LCA. Next.js 16, Convex, Turso.

items.name: h1b-service
items.description: H-1B sponsorship signal API from DOL LCA + USCIS Employer Data Hub

items.name: H1B-Data-Analysis
items.description: ETL on DOL H1-B LCA data to perform analytics using PySpark

items.name: h1b-lca-tool
items.description: H-1B LCA Wage Clarity Engine — Streamlit app for DOL wage level analysis, BLS OES live data, and filing risk assessment

items.name: h1b-100k-fee-analysis
items.description: Empirical decomposition of the $100,000 H-1B fee at the LCA filing stage (DOL LCA microdata, Sept 2025 cutoff + ITS robustness).

items.name: h1b-sponsor-scout
items.description: Which employers sponsor H-1B for OR, analytics, quant & IE roles? Pipeline over 1.1M DOL LCA records (FY2024–25)

items.name: h1b-wage-analytics
items.description: US tech H-1B wages and sponsorship FY2022-FY2026: PostgreSQL + SQL analysis of 2.7M DOL LCA filings, Tableau Public exports

items.name: h1b-wage-level-analyzer
items.description: Exploratory analysis of H-1B wage classification patterns across Fortune 500 sponsors using Python, SQL, and DuckDB — FY2024 DOL LCA data
